title: ironwork-fuzz-interface/v1
description: DIR/manifest.json of ironwork fuzz --interface, which runs a subprogram as a caller would, with generated arguments for its PROCEDURE DIVISION USING items (docs/evidence.md section 5.2).

format.description: The manifest's shape. A reader of ironwork-fuzz/v1 refuses it: it would take the arguments for a main program's inputs.

version.description: The ironwork release that wrote the manifest.

seed.description: The --seed the inputs were generated from; the same seed gives the same runs.

strategy.description: How inputs are generated: field by field from the record and parameter descriptions.

clock.description: The time every run's clock was fixed at, --clock or 2026-01-01.

file.description: The subprogram, by path from --root, the current directory without it.

id.description: The PROGRAM-ID, or for a job the job's name.

roots.description: The directories the runs read, numbered as a journal's input records number them: the subprogram's directory, then each -I and -L library.

items.description: A root by its path from --root, . for --root itself, null for one outside it.

entry.description: Each run was an ironwork run of the subprogram with --argument, one per USING item.

inputs.description: The inputs of the kept runs.

counts.description: Outcomes over the generated runs; an abend that says what the surroundings lack counts as refused.

clean.description: Runs that ended without an abend.

abend.description: Runs that ended in an abend the input may have caused.

refused.description: Runs that say nothing of the program's input: ironwork refused them, panicked, or the abend names what the surroundings lack.

callers.description: Each static CALL of the subprogram by name in its directory or an -L library, the shape a run may take its arguments from.

file.description: The calling source, by path from --root, or the COPY member the CALL is in.

runCoverage.description: The coverage of every run the fuzz run made, by path from DIR: coverage/runs.json, with how many runs started each statement and entered each paragraph (docs/evidence.md §5). Absent from a manifest written before ironwork kept it.

input.description: One argument of a kept run.

id.description: The id a run's input array names it by.

kind.description: An argument passed to a PROCEDURE DIVISION USING item.

name.description: The USING item the argument is passed to.

bytes.description: The argument's bytes in base64, as the LINKAGE record lays them out; empty when OMITTED.

minimized.description: False when minimizing ran out of runs before the input was as small as still gives the abend.

position.description: The USING item's place in the PROCEDURE DIVISION USING list, from 0.

omitted.description: The argument was OMITTED: a null address, as the CALL it was shaped by passes.

run.description: A kept run: its inputs, its abend, and the journal and coverage of its run with --evidence.

abend.description: The abend the run ended with.

code.description: The abend code: S0C7, U4038, ASRA, S322 and so on.

file.description: The source it ended in, relative to the root that supplied it.

message.description: The message the run ended with.

optimized.description: Whether the same input, compiled with OPTIMIZE(2), ends in the same abend at the same file and line. True without a run for S322 and a CEE3501S's U4038, which OPTIMIZE cannot change.

journal.description: The run id of its journal under evidence/runs.

coverage.description: Its coverage, in run --coverage's format, by path from DIR.

limit.description: The statement limit the run was given (run --statement-limit): a kept S322's place depends on it. Absent for a run with no limit.
